## 🚀 Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 💡 Use Case
**Who would benefit from this feature?**
- [ ] End users (developers using the API)
- [ ] Contributors
- [ ] Maintainers
- [ ] General public

**Example scenario:**
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

## 🎯 Implementation Ideas
**Technical suggestions (if any):**
- API endpoints needed
- UI changes required
- Data structure modifications
- New dependencies

## 📊 Priority
**How important is this feature?**
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Would improve user experience significantly
- [ ] High - Critical for project success

## 🔍 Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## 🏷️ Labels
Please consider adding relevant labels:
- `feature-request` (already added)
- `enhancement` (already added)
- `hacktoberfest` (if suitable for Hacktoberfest)
- `good first issue` (if suitable for beginners)
- `help wanted` (if community assistance is needed)

### For Contributors
- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] I would like to work on implementing this feature
- [ ] I understand this may require discussion before implementation
